proof: For a fixed proper noncircular ellipse and strictly nested confocal elliptic caustic, on each family of odd physical least period N≥3 the product of sums of the ordinary distances from the two foci to the complete original side lines is constant. It equals β²[Σ_j 1/dn(4Kj/N | m)]². Coprime windings, stars and reversal are covered. r repetitions multiply the product by r².

Difference-addition gives the real contact chord normal and line, with finite positive norm. The focal terms (1±k sn)/dn have no sign ambiguity. Phase shifts give a full 4K grid by coprimality. The quarter-period identities turn the two sums into dn and cn traces with unequal amplitudes.

By absolute Fourier convergence and root-of-unity filtering, for odd N the surviving dn and cn modes are exactly those matching the nome q^N. The correctly normalized traces yield D²−mH² constant. Grid symmetry at phase zero gives the displayed value; N parity is essential. At even period four, the same fixed caustic has exact diamond and rectangle products 8 and 9. Circular case direct.
